name: motion-grid-diagonal
title: Grid Diagonal Wave
description: Lưới 4×4 ô trượt chéo từ dưới trái vào, các ô cùng đường chéo tới cùng lúc.

moworks.author: moworks

options.offset: [x, y] px it comes from ([−72, 72]): from the lower left

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 4×4 tiles (28 px, 34 px pitch) slide in from the lower-left: x −18 → 0, y +18 → 0 px, opacity in over the first half, each 472 ms power3.out, delay (row + col) × 78 ms (940 ms in all); tiles on one diagonal arrive together (alternate diagonals in two colours, delay labels in the demo). Params: offset (−18, +18 px) · step (78 ms) · each (0.472 s) · ease (power3.out). Tiles on one diagonal arrive together.
